name: Акробатический кувырок
subject: An agile green-hooded leather-armored ranger in a compact tucked forward-roll pose, head low and knees folded toward chest, a thin pale emerald semicircular movement swoosh follows rotation behind back/boots. Bow secured across back with quiver, hands close to body, no loose sharp arrow, no protective aura, no double body. Clear roll silhouette on navy forest background.
caption: Компактный кувырок Лучника со следом вращения, без защитной ауры.
